source.title: A warp drive with predominantly positive invariant energy density and global Hawking-Ellis Type I
source.author: Jose Rodal
source.relationship: Exact published metric family, standardized parameters; no claim of a global state-of-the-art minimum.

benchmark.coordinate_frame: comoving q=(x_lab-2ct,y,z); ray times in SI seconds

energy.error_kind: Displayed value: refined 40/48 per-cell numerical quadrature estimate. Separate replayed outward continuum enclosure; no formal Lean GR certificate.

geometry.contour_meaning: Reference F levels only. A perturbed geometry need not have spherical shift or density contours.

optical_cache.encoding: two RGBA float32 little-endian textures; A,B,C,D / E,F,0,0

audit.scope: Seeded off-grid samples, including poles/inner wall; not global error bounds.

status.numerical: Replayed continuum bounds and geometric caps; separate research scenario
